scripts.build:layers: npm run build:snowflake && npm run build:encoding
scripts.db:setup: npm run docker:up && sleep 3 && npm run db:migrate
scripts.sam:build:watch: chokidar 'src/**/*.ts' -c 'sam build && docker ps -q --filter name=sam | xargs -r docker kill' --debounce 500 --silent
scripts.dev:setup: npm run build:layers && npm run docker:up && npm run sam:build
scripts.dev: npm run dev:setup && concurrently --names 'SAM,WATCH' --prefix-colors 'cyan,magenta' 'npm run sam:start' 'npm run sam:build:watch'
scripts.dev:clean: npm run docker:down && rm -rf infra/lambda-layers/snowflake/dist infra/lambda-layers/encoding/dist .aws-sam
